chalisa.do1: Victory to Gaṇeśa, son of Girijā, the merciful bringer of good. Remove the sorrows of the humble, Lord, and make them glad.
chalisa.do2: Victory, victory to the Lord, Śrī Śanideva; hear my prayer, great king. Show grace, son of Ravi, and keep the honour of your devotee.
chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory to merciful Śanideva, who ever cares for his devotees. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Four arms and a dark body shine; on his head a jewelled crown gives splendour. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: His forehead is supremely broad and charming; his gaze is oblique, his brows fearsome. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: Earrings glitter brightly in his ears; on his chest a garland of pearls and gems gleams. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: In his hands are a mace, a trident and an axe; in a moment he destroys his enemies. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: Piṅgala, Kṛṣṇa, Chāyānandana, Yama, Koṇastha, Raudra, Duḥkhabhañjana, ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: Sauri, Manda and Śani: these are the ten names. Through the son of Bhānu every wish is fulfilled. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Whoever the Lord is pleased with, even a pauper, he makes a king in a moment. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: At his glance even a mountain becomes a blade of grass, and he turns even a blade of grass into a mountain. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Just as the kingdom was coming to him, you gave Śrī Rāma the forest, and took away even Kaikeyī's judgement. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: In the forest too you showed the deceiving deer, and Mother Jānakī was carried off. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: The Śakti weapon struck Lakṣmaṇa down in anguish, and an outcry arose in the army. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: Rāvaṇa's state and mind went astray, and he deepened his enmity with Śrī Rāma. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: You turned golden Laṅkā into dross, and the drum of the hero Bajaraṅga's fame was sounded. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: You set your foot on King Vikrama, and the peacock in the painting swallowed the necklace. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: The theft of the nine-lakh necklace was laid on him, and you had his hands and feet broken. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: You showed him a heavy, wretched period, and made him turn the oil-press in an oil-presser's house. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: When he made his prayer in the Dīpaka rāga, the Lord was pleased and gave him happiness. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: King Hariścandra's wife was sold, and he himself carried water in a Ḍom's house. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: In the same way your period ran its course over Nala, and the roasted fish leapt into the water. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: When you went and seized Śrī Śiva, you made Pārvatī give up her body as Satī. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: Taking slight offence, with a single look, you sent the head of Gaurī's son flying into the sky. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Your period came upon the Pāṇḍavas, and Draupadī was barely saved from being stripped. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: You struck down the state and mind of the Kauravas too, and brought about the Mahābhārata war. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: You took Ravi into your mouth at once, and with him leapt down into the netherworld. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Seeing this, the rest of the gods made entreaty, and you released Ravi from your mouth. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: The Lord has seven mounts, know them well: in the world, the elephant of the quarters, the donkey, the deer, the dog, ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: the jackal, the lion and other clawed beasts. Astrology proclaims their fruits aloud. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: When he comes on the elephant, Lakṣmī comes to the house; through the horse he brings forth happiness and wealth. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: The donkey brings loss in many undertakings; the lion brings success in the royal court and society. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: The jackal destroys the intellect; the deer brings hardship and takes life. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: When the Lord comes riding the dog, there is great fear of theft and the like. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Likewise there are four feet, and these are their names: gold, iron, silver and copper. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: When the Lord comes on the iron foot, he brings ruin to wealth, people and property. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Copper and silver bring evenness and are auspicious; gold brings every happiness and great blessing. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Whoever sings this story of Śani daily is never troubled by a wretched period. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: The Lord shows wondrous play, and makes the enemy's sinews and strength go slack. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Whoever calls a competent paṇḍita and has the rite of peace for the planet Śani performed according to rule, ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: and offers water to the pīpal tree on Śani's day and gives lamps, gains much happiness. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Rāmasundara Prabhudāsa says: by remembering Śani, happiness comes to light. ॥40॥
chalisa.do3: A devotee has prepared this reading of Śanīścara Deva. Reading it for forty days, one crosses the ocean of worldly existence.
